identity.name: Bússola
identity.description: A disciplinary management platform that prioritizes clarity, legal precision, and ease of use for HR and Management.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and modal titles. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all standard text, table data, and form inputs. Tracking normal.

mono.usage: Use for IDs, reference codes, and audit logs.

layout.spacing: Generous padding (p-6 to p-8) for containers, tight gaps (gap-4) for data density.

sidebar.style: Fixed, dark navy background (#1B2A4E), white text, high contrast active states.

structure: Summary Cards (Top Row): 4 columns, key metrics.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border (border-slate-200), no shadow or very subtle shadow-sm. White background.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1B2A4E] hover:bg-[#1B2A4E]/90 text-white rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1B2A4E]/20 focus:border-[#1B2A4E] rounded-md h-10

tables.style: Dense, clear headers (uppercase, text-xs, text-slate-500), row hover effects (hover:bg-slate-50).

badges.style: Pill-shaped, px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full border

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers or modal overlays (backdrop-blur-sm).
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid decorative gradients. Use solid colors for authority.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (clean, stroke-based). Use 1.5px stroke width.

login_background.usage: Full screen background for Login/Auth pages with a dark overlay (bg-slate-900/80).

placeholders.usage: Use as a fallback for user avatars or team sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1. Use Slate-600+ for text on white.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-offset-2) for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.aria: All interactive elements must have aria-labels if no text is present.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a 'Swiss Utility' interface. Prioritize data density and clarity over decoration. This is a legal/HR tool, so it must feel precise.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_rules: Use a fixed sidebar layout for the main app. Use a centered card layout for authentication.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_overrides: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Legal Navy' theme. Override default radius to '0.5rem' (rounded-lg).
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts with the defined status colors. Avoid rainbow palettes.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, and major containers.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
